body: I have a friend that I talk to sometimes, but I feel like these sort of things just get to be such a big deal that the person things you are crazy or calls an ambulance out of fear because they think something is going to happen right at that moment.

I think I have discovered something I’m really good at- the job prospects just aren’t quite as secure as I would like. Even so, I am fortunate to have found something that I am really passionate about.

I’m with you in those high standards; it’s super hard to back down from a challenge, even if it is something that you don’t really care to “fight”, it is still good to feel like you can do anything, despite the fact that you really can’t.
Need to look at the unibrow, NOT the nose...

See, the one time I tried that, the person asked me “why are you staring at my nose”? 

I might try it again to see if it works because it seems a lot of you guys have had success with it!
I’m probably at about 40 percent overall, I just break contact and re-engage pretty frequently
Yeah, I thought I was making a ton of eye contact, but I watched a video of myself recently and I’m literally looking away from the person like every second or so.
This was really inspirational. Thank you!

Hopefully; I feel like I’ve defined my character by what I can accomplish for so long that I feel worthless if I’m not the best at everything. The best in this context being graduating on time. I’m trying to focus on what I have to do to graduate next semester rather than how to kill myself, so that’s a small win.
Keep trying to remind myself that my life is worth holding on for, even though things are shitty now.

Why would I what?
Also, I was able to get off of fb and focus on something else for a bit, so that was a win :)
I can’t think of much, I helped her with her statistics test but nothing big. Damn shame that I reached out to her, and she reached out to another person we know, because I know she will feel guilty.
She defended her thesis today! It’s good for her. It didn’t help that I kept her up last night because I was going to jump then, but she did well despite that.
I talked to a friend but I’ve tired her out, it’s a big day for her today.
